input.title: Need the map's content before writing alt text for /img/map.png
input.rationale: The on the Contact page has no alt attribute. I tried to load the image to see what it shows, but it failed to load. I won't write alt text based on the file name or a guess. A map on a contact page usually shows where a business is, so it's probably informative and not decorative. Useful alt text would give the location, such as the address or nearby landmarks. I need a reviewer to tell me what the map shows.

question.text: The map image (/img/map.png) failed to load, so I can't see it. What location does it show? Please give the address or place name to use in the alt text, or say if the image is purely decorative.
options: It shows our location; the address is: (please provide)
It is decorative or repeats an address already in the page text, so use an empty alt
Other (please describe what the image shows)
